findings.finding: This cutover makes the coordinator/fuse route the DEFAULT for six non-create families, yet every named test mechanism is offline: 'verified-fake' Cloud/DC batches and a replay of a sanitized synthetic 1,200-run fixture. No acceptance criterion exercises the newly-defaulted coordinator route end-to-end against the real dispatch boundary (the `execute` closure delegating to `dispatch_one`), so the suite can close green while the live defaulted path is broken — the proxy-validation anti-pattern for a cutover.
scenarios: The verified-fake and synthetic-replay suites pass, the family default flips to coordinator, but the live execute-closure adapter (abort_check/HEAD-drift threading + dispatch_one delegation) mis-wires against the real boundary and only surfaces in production against a real repo/endpoint
findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC requiring at least one non-create family to route through coordinate_and_fuse against a real (or contract-faithful integration) dispatch boundary, asserting the rebar-id stamp, guard ordering, and fuse outcome are produced by the live path rather than a fake.
